headline: China discovers new lithium deposits: mine resources jump 70 percent, here is what it means for the global market
summary: China has increased resources at the Jiajia lithium deposit in Sichuan Province by about 70%. The added lithium carbonate equivalent is roughly 0.7% of global lithium reserves, according to the South China Morning Post.
why: Lithium is a key input for batteries used in electric vehicles and energy storage, so reserve changes affect the metal's long-term supply outlook.
